title: The Best Chinese Songs of 2024 - with Concrete Avalanche
text: My name is Jake and I write a free newsletter about music from China called Concrete Avalanche. I'm here to play you serve my favourite tracks from 2024 so far. And over the next hour or so you can hear a thing from psychedelic rock to rare week of folk accus and from Beijing, Kauai, Kau to Tibetan Buddhist chants mixed with footwork. Thanks to China Talk for havinguilding me here. I'm going to show up now and play some music.
